name: comprehensive-security-audit
description: Deep, read-only, multi-agent security audit skill for Claude Code. Maps an app's business model and trust boundaries first, derives a domain-specific audit plan from that (auth, IDOR, financial flows, admin/privilege, data exposure, secrets/config, plus conditional domains like KYC, escrow, marketplace bidding, or NDPA data-protection compliance), runs parallel subagents per domain, independently verifies the highest-severity claims, and delivers one synthesized report.
